explanations: The point 'zng' is chosen for a top-down grip because it is centrally located on the lid of the box, providing optimal control.
A close gripper action is required to securely grasp the lid.
The 'pla' surface is pulled perpendicular to its normal vector to lift the lid open effectively.
Retracting the gripper ensures a safe distance after opening the box.
Opening the gripper releases the lid after opening.
